title: Hotel reputation across six review sites
description: Three row types share one dataset: reputation (one hotel on one review site), summary (one hotel across every site checked) and status (one hotel per site, including the sites that found nothing). Every row is free.

dataset.title: Reputation rows
dataset.description: One row per hotel per review site with the rating, review count, ranking and sub-scores, plus a cross-source summary row and a status row per check. Nothing here is charged.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record: how many hotels were checked, how many sites answered, how many were not found, and the HTTP stats of every source.
